messages:
Alex G: Quick heads-up — Acme asked to add semantic search + live rerank to the POC, and they want BYO-KMS plus a 99th pctl tail latency target <200ms. Can we fit this into the 3-week trial?
Priya S: @Alex G that's a big scope jump. embeddings + rerank + BYO-KMS + tighter latency = infra + security + eval work. Need to call out tradeoffs.
Sam T: Can we give them options? They said budget is tight.
Marco R: Tech perspective: offline rerank (embeddings + batch scoring) is fast to implement. Live rerank needs a rerank-proxy and continuous batching; it increases tail latency risk under concurrency. With a dedicated quantized model and small memcache we could approach p99 ~200ms for short contexts, but depends on QPS and doc length.
Priya S: Proposal: define clear success criteria so we can sell the tradeoffs. Example: 1) Top-5 rerank precision >= 0.70 on their eval set; 2) End-to-end median latency <100ms, p99 <250ms for 95% of traffic; 3) BYO-KMS integrated and audit logs available; 4) Deliver eval report and cost estimate.
Jing L: BYO-KMS has a separate onboarding path — needs contract addendum, KMS config review, and network/VPC design. Typical lead time 7-10 business days for enterprise customers (legal + infra).
Alex G: If BYO-KMS adds 7-10 days, we can't finish by EOW. Customer said timeline is important. Can we phase it?
Marco R: Yes: Phase A = embeddings + offline rerank + evals (week 1-2). Phase B = live rerank + BYO-KMS onboarding (week 3+), contingent on legal sign-off and their corpus sizing.
Priya S: I'll draft a revised SOW with those phases and explicit acceptance criteria.
Sam T: They also want pricing for both options (hosted vs dedicated). @Priya S can you give a ballpark so I can push for budget?
Priya S: Hosted: incremental cost approx +$X/day (tokens + embeddings). Dedicated: reserved capacity bump estimate ~$Y/month (depends on model size and QPS). I'll DM specific numbers and include a variance for high-doc-length.
Jing L: Security note: for BYO-KMS we require IAM role mapping, key rotation policy, and audit log forwarding. Please ask customer to complete the security questionnaire and send current SOC2 report.
ops-bot: deploy-notification: canary for rerank-proxy scheduled Wed 09:00 UTC — heads up to eng.
Marco R: One more technical blocker: their sample docs are long (avg ~1200 tokens). We should propose a chunking strategy for embeddings or advise trimming to keep latency down. Long contexts will blow up token counts and cost.
Alex G: I'll request a sample corpus and 100 labeled pairs for evaluation by EOD.
Priya S: Also request their target QPS and percent of traffic that needs live rerank (e.g., 10% vs 100%). That changes the infra design.
Sam T: I'll coordinate legal for the BYO-KMS addendum and check whether the customer will accept delayed BYO-KMS delivery in exchange for earlier demo.
Alex G: Thanks all — I'll send the revised SOW and option matrix to the customer today and post the doc here. :thumbsup:
